notesStmt.note: On the reverse is a partial postmark for 1884, so this manuscript must date to late 1884 or sometime before August in 1885.

note.p: This is a draft line for "You Tides with Ceaseless Swell," first published along with seven other poems in the August 1885 issue of Nineteenth Century under the collective title "Fancies at Navesink." The sequence was later reprinted in November Boughs (1888).

lg.l:
*What potent spells ‸ from the do
distant suns worlds stars upon send to you?
what Sirius? what Autares?
